Amharic: ሙሉ የጂኖም ቅደም ተከተል ቴክኒኮችን በመጠቀም ከበሽተኞቹ ናሙናዎች የተለዩትን የባክቴሪያዎች ጄኔቲካዊ ቅደም ተከተል ለይተዋል እንዲሁም እንደ ጾታ፣ ዕድሜ፣ የኤችአይቪ ሁኔታ እና የቲቢ ታሪክ ያሉ የታማሚ ባህሪያትን ተመልክተዋል።

Source: The researchers found a mismatch between their WGS results and hospital results for 22% of the patients.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula nga waliwo enjawulo wakati w’ebyo bye baazuulanga bakozesa enkola ya WGS n’ebyo amalwaliro bye gaazuula mu balwadde abakola ebitundu 22%.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣewádìí rí àìdọ́gba láàárín èsì WGS wọn àti èsì ilé ìwòsàn fún 22% àwọn aláìsàn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukungafani phakathi kwemiphumela yabo ye-WGS nemiphumela yasesibhedlela ku-22% weziguli.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun sami rashin daidaituwa a tsakanin sakamakon WGS da sakamakon asibiti na kashi 22% na marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hwditše go se sepelelane magareng ga dipoelo tša bona tša WGS le dipoelo tša dipetlele go 22% ya balwetši.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ለ22% ታማሚዎች በሙ.ጂ.ቅ ውጤታቸው እና በሆስፒታል ውጤታቸው መካከል አለመመጣጠንን አግኝተዋል።

Source: They also found that hospitals only tested resistance for just a few TB drugs.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baazuula ng’amalwaliro gaakebera obugugubi ku ddagala lya TB ettonotono.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ri pé àwọn ilé ìwòsàn kán ṣe ìdánwò ìtakò fún àwọn ògùn TB díẹ̀.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi izibhedlela zazihlola kuphela imishanguzo embalwa ye-TB.
Hausa: Sun kuma gano cewa asibitocin sun gwada juriya ne kawai na magungunan TB.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gape gore dipetlele di be di dira diteko fela tša go šita dihlare  fela go dihlare tše mmalwa tša TB.
Amharic: ሆስፒታሎች የመቋቋም አቅምን የሚፈትሹት ለጥቂት የቲቢ መድሃኒቶች ብቻ እንደሆነም ደርሰውበታል።

Source: They said that more than half (58%) of isolates were not resistant to any TB drug, while only 6% were resistant to just 1 drug, 25% were resistant to up to 4 drugs, and 4% were resistant to more than 4 drugs.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ettundutundu erisinga obunene (58%) ery’obuwuka obwekalirizibwa lyali teririna kika kya ddagala lya TB kyonna kye lirinako bugugubi, ate ng’obuwuka obukola ebitundu 6% bwali bugugubira eddagala lya kika 1, obuwuka obukola ebitundu 25% bwali bugugubira eddagala lya bika 4, nga n’obuwuka obukoa ebitundu 4% bwali bugugubira eddagala erisukka mu bika 4.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé ó kọjá ìdajì (58%) àwọn ẹ̀dà tí wọn kò tako ògùn TB kankan tí 6% nìkan ló tako ògùn 1 nìkan, 25% tako ògùn tó tó 4, àti 4% tako ju ògùn 4 lọ.
Zulu: Bathe ngaphezu kwengxenye (58%) yabantu ababodwa abazweli kunoma yimuphi umuthi we-TB, kuyilapho ama-6% kuphela angazweli emuthini o-1 kuphela, ama-25% awazweli emithini e-4, kanti ama-4% awazweli ezidakamizweni ezingaphezu kwe-4.
Hausa: Sun ce fiye da rabi (58%) na keɓewar ba sa jure wa duk wani maganin TB, a yayin da kashi 6% kawai yake jure maganin 1 kawai, kashi 25% kuma suna jure wa magunguna 4, kuma kashi 4% suna jure wa fiye da magunguna 4.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore palo ya go feta seripagare (58%) sa bao ba arogantšwego ba be ba sa palele sehlare sefe goba sefe sa TB, mola e le gore ke fela 6% ye e bego e palelwa fela sehlare se 1, 25% e be e palelwa dihlare tša go fihla go tše 4, gomme 4% yona e be e šita dihlare tša go feta tše 4.
Amharic: ከግማሽ በላይ የሚሆኑት (58%) ልይቶች ለየትኛውም የቲቢ መድሃኒት ተቋቋሚ እንዳልሆኑ፤ 6% ብቻ ለ1 መድሃኒት ብቻ ተቋቋሚ እንደሆኑ፤ 25% የሚሆኑት እስከ 4 መድሃኒቶች እና 4% የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ከ4 በላይ መድሃኒቶችን እንደሚቋቋሙ ገልጸዋል።

Source: They reported that between 12% and 15% of patients died during treatment, or received the wrong treatment.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abalwadde abali wakati w’ebitundu 12% n’ebitundu 15% baafa nga bajjanjabibwa, oba baafuna eddagala erikyamu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n mú ẹjọ́ wá pé láàárín 12% àti 15% àwọn aláìsàn tó kù nígbà tí wọ́n ń gba ìwòsàn, tàbí tí wọ́n ń gba ìwòsàn tí kò yẹ.
Zulu: Babike ukuthi phakathi kwama-12% nama-15% weziguli zishone ngesikhathi zelashwa, noma zithole imishanguzo engafanele.
Hausa: Sun bayar da rahoton cewa a tsakanin kashi 12% zuwa 15% na marasa lafiya sun mutu a lokacin jiyya, ko kuma sun sami magani mara kyau.
Northern Sotho: Ba begile gore magareng ga 12% le 15% ya balwetši ba hlokofetše ka nakong ya kalafo, goba ba hweditše kalafo ye e phošagetšego.
Amharic: ከ12% እስከ 15% የሚሆኑ ታማሚዎች በህክምና ወቅት እንደሞቱ ወይም የተሳሳተ ህክምና እንዳገኙ ሪፖርት አድርገዋል።

Source: Out of those who died, very few (6%) were resistant to only 1 drug, while most (39%) were resistant to many drugs.
Luganda: Mu abo abaafa, batono nnyo (6%) abaalina obugugubi ku ddagala lya kika 1, olwo ng’abasinga obungi (39%) baalina obugugubi ku ddagala lingi.
Yoruba: Lára àwọn tó kú, díẹ̀ (6%) lára wọn ni ara wọn tako ògùn 1 nìkan, tí púpọ̀ (39%) lára wọn ni ara wọn kọ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ògùn.
Zulu: Kulabo abashonile, bambalwa kakhulu (6%) abebengazweli emuthini o-1 kuphela, kanti iningi (39%) lalingazweli emithini eminingi.
Hausa: A cikin waɗanda suka mutu, kaɗan ne (6%) suke jurewa magani 1 kacal, yayin da akasari (39%) suke jurewa magunguna da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Go bao ba hlokofetšego, ke ba mmalwanyana fela (6%) bao ba bego ba palelago fela sehlare se 1, mola ba bantši (39%) ba be ba palela dihlare tša ntši.
Amharic: ከሞቱት መካከል ጥቂቶቹ (6%) ለ1 መድሃኒት ብቻ ተቋቋሚ ሲሆኑ አብዛኛዎቹ (39%) ለብዙ መድሃኒቶች ተቋቋሚ ነበሩ።

Source: Also, patients who were not getting enough treatment were more likely to die from TB.
Luganda: N’ekirala, abalwadde abaali batafuna bujjanjabi bumala baalina emikisa mingi egy’okufa olwa TB.
Yoruba: Ní àfikún, àwọn aláìsàn tí wọn kò rí ìtọ́jú tó péye lè padà kú nípasẹ̀ TB.
Zulu: Futhi iziguli ezazingatholi ukwelashwa okwanele zazisemathubeni amaningi okuthi zibulawe yi-TB.
Hausa: Haka nan, marasa lafiya da ba sa samun isasshen magani sun fi mutuwa daga TB.
Northern Sotho: Gape, balwetši bao ba bego ba sa hwetše kalafo ye e lekanego go be go na le kgonagalo ye kgolo ya gore ba ka hlokofala ka lebaka la TB.
Amharic: እንዲሁም በቂ ህክምና የማያገኙ ታማሚዎች በቲቢ በሽታ የመሞት ዕድላቸው ከፍተኛ ነበር።

Source: In conclusion, the researchers said they were able to find more bacteria that were resistant to 1 drug using the sequencing technique compared to other hospital testing methods.
Luganda: Mu kuwunzika, abanoonyereza baagamba nti baasobola okuzuula obuwuka bwa bakitiriya bungi obwali bugugubira eddagala lya kika 1 nga bakozesa enkola y’okusengeka bw’ogeraageranya n’obukodyo bw’okukebera obulala obukozesebwa mu malwaliro.
Yoruba: Ní àkótán, àwọn àṣewádìí sọ pé àwọn tún ṣàwárí àwọn kòkòrò tuntun tí wọ́n ń tako ògùn 1 nípa ìlò ìgbésẹ̀ ṣísẹ̀ntẹ̀lé yàtọ̀ sí ọ̀nà tí àwọn ilé ìwòsàn míràn ń ṣe ìdánwò wọn.
Zulu: Esiphethweni, abacwaningi bathi bakwazile ukuthola amabhaktheriya amaningi abengazweli emuthini o-1 besebenzisa indlela yokulandelana uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izindlela zokuhlola esibhedlela.
Hausa: A ƙarshe, masu binciken sun ce sun sami damar samun ƙarin ƙwayoyin bakteriya waɗanda suke jurewa maganin 1 ta hanyar amfani da dabarar da aka kwatanta da sauran hanyoyin gwajin asibiti.
Northern Sotho: Ge ba tšea sephetho, banyakišiši ba boletše gore ba kgonne go hwetša dipaktheria tše ntši tšeo di bego di palela sehlare se 1 ba šomiša mokgwa wa tatelanyo ge go bapetšwa le dipetlele tšeo di šomišago mekgwa ya go dira diteko.
Amharic: በማጠቃለያው ተመራማሪዎቹ ከሌሎች የሆስፒታል መመርመሪያ ዘዴዎች ጋር ሲነጻጸሩ የቅደም ተከተል ቴክኒኮችን በመጠቀም ለ1 መድሃኒት ተቋቋሚ የሆኑ ብዙ ባክቴሪያዎችን ማግኘት ችለዋል ብለዋል።

Source: However, the researchers said their findings were only for TB patients who were HIV positive.
Luganda: Wabula, abanoonyereza baagamba nti bye baazuula byali bikwata ku balwadde ba TB bokka abaalina akawuka ka HIV.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀ṣíbẹ̀, àwọn àṣewádìí sọ pé ìwádìí wọ́n wà fún àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní TB àti HIV nìkan.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, abacwaningi bathe abakuthola ngokweziguli ezine-TB ezine-HIV kuphela.
Hausa: Sai dai masu binciken sun ce binciken nasu na masu TB ne kawai waɗanda suke ɗauke da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, banyakišiši ba boletše gore dikutollo tša bona di be di le fela tša balwetši ba TB bao ba bego ba na le HIV.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ ተመራማሪዎቹ ግኝቶቻቸው በኤችአይቪ ለተያዙ የቲቢ በሽተኞች ብቻ እንደሆኑ ተናግረዋል።

Source: They also said they could not study drug resistance between different TB bacteria varieties because of the small number (582) of samples.
Luganda: Baayongerako era ne bagamba nti tebaasobola kwekaliriza bugugubi bw’eddagala wakati w’obuwuka obw’enjawulo obuleeta TB olwa sampolo entono ze baalina (582).
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé wọn ò rí iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ṣe lórí àìfàyègba ìṣiṣẹ́ oògùn àti oríṣiríṣi kòkòrò TB tí ó wà nítorí ìwọ̀nba (582) ni ẹ̀dà tí ó wà.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi ngeke bakwazi ukufunda ukumelana nemithi phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zamagciwane e-TB ngenxa yenani elincane (582) lamasampula.
Hausa: Har wa yau, sun ce ba za su iya yin nazari a kan juriya da magunguna a tsakanin nau'in bakteriyar cutar TB saboda ƙarancin adadin (582) na samfurori.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gape gore ga se ba kgona go nyakišiva ka ga go šita ga dihlare magareng ga mehutahuta ya dipaktheria tša TB ka lebaka la palo (582) ya fasana ya disampole.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም አነስተኛ ቁጥር (582) ባላቸው ናሙናዎች ምክንያት በተለያዩ የቲቢ ባክቴሪያ ዓይነቶች መካከል ያለውን የመድሃኒት ተጋትሮ አቅም ማጥናት እንዳልቻሉ ገልጸዋል።

Source: Regardless, the researchers say their results support the World Health Organisation’s call for point-of-care tests based on WGS.
Luganda: Ebyo nga biri awo, abanoonyereza bagamba nti bye baazuula biwagira omulanga gw’Ekitongole ky’Ebyobulamu mu Nsi yonna ogw’okukola okukebera okwesigamye ku nkola ya WGS mu bifo ewafunibwa obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Láìfikan pèkan, àwọn àṣewádìí sọ pé èsì wọn fará mọ ìpè Àjọ tó ń Mójú tó Ètò Ìlera Lágbàáyé fún ìdánwò ojú-ìtọ́jú tí ó dúró lé WGS.
Zulu: Kungakhathaliseki, abacwaningi bathi imiphumela yabo isekela isimemo se-World Health Organization sokuhlolwa kwamaphuzu okunakekelwa okusekelwe ku-WGS.
Hausa: Ko da kuwa, masu binciken sun ce sakamakonsu yana goyan bayan kiran Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya don gwaje-gwajen kulawa bisa WGS.
Northern Sotho: Go sa kgathale, banyakišiši ba boletše gore dipoelo tša bopna di thekgile boipiletšo bja Mokgatlo wa Maphelo wa Lefase bja diteko tša mafelo a kalafo go lebeletšwe WGS.
Amharic: ምንም ይሁን ምን ተመራማሪዎቹ ውጤቶቻቸው የዓለም አቀፍ የጤና ድርጅት ጥሪ የሆኑትን በሙ.ጂ.ቅ ላይ የተመሰረቱትን የጤና-ጥበቃ-ምርመራዎችን እንደሚደግፉ ተናግረዋል።
